## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

# Exercício 1 — O documento e a leitura

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
mel_long <- mel_2023 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = jan:dez,
    names_to = "mes",
    values_to = "mel"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mes = factor(
      mes,
      levels = c(
        "jan", "fev", "mar", "abr", "mai", "jun",
        "jul", "ago", "set", "out", "nov", "dez"
      )
    )
  )
nrow(mel_long)

sum(is.na(mel_long$mel))
```
```{r}
mel_cadastro <- mel_long %>%
  left_join(
    cadastro,
    by = join_by(codigo)
  )
nrow(mel_cadastro)
mel_cadastro <- mel_cadastro %>%
  mutate(
    mel_relativo = mel / colmeias
  )
```
```{r}
anti_join(
  cadastro,
  mel_long,
  by = join_by(codigo)
)
```

```{r}
resumo_unidade <- mel_cadastro %>%
  group_by(codigo, nome, florada) %>%
  summarise(
    meses_com_registro = sum(!is.na(mel)),
    total_ano = sum(mel, na.rm = TRUE),
    media_mensal_relativa = mean(mel_relativo, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
resumo_unidade
```

```{r}
resumo_categoria <- mel_cadastro %>%
  group_by(florada) %>%
  summarise(
    unidades = n_distinct(codigo),
    total_ano = sum(mel, na.rm = TRUE),
    media_mensal_relativa = mean(mel_relativo, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
resumo_categoria
```

```{r}
sum(resumo_categoria$total_ano)
```

O total anual de mel registrado em 2023 foi de `r format(sum(resumo_categoria$total_ano), decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = ".")` kg.
